issues.what: the change across the hook is slow and incremental: the loop brightens and rises a little and the camera pushes in slightly, but no single event lands that rewards staying; at phone size frames 1-5 look almost identical
issues.fix: front-load a clear event in the first second, such as the loop snapping or erupting, a flare burst at a footpoint, or a faster push toward the arch, so the motion reads at thumbnail size

issues.what: in the first frame the loop is thin, dim and only partly formed, so the hero subject is weaker than the granulated surface below it
issues.fix: open with the arch already bright and fully drawn, or raise its brightness and thickness in frame 0 so it is the first thing the eye catches

issues.what: the granulation fills about half the frame with busy, similar-value detail that competes with the loop and turns to texture noise at 400 px wide
issues.fix: lower the horizon or darken and defocus the near-field granulation so the arch and sunspot dominate

issues.what: the wide landscape framing leaves the subject small on a vertical feed and puts about 40 percent of the frame into dark starfield
issues.fix: crop tighter on the arch and sunspot or recompose for a vertical delivery
